name: biceps-curl-barbell-prone-incline
title: Biceps Curl: Barbell (Prone, Incline)
primer: This exercise uses an incline bench to change your body's position as you perform Biceps Curls. The movement is very similar to a Preacher Curl.
steps: Adjust an incline bench to a 45 degree angle.
Grasp a barbell with a shoulder width grip and lean face down against the bench, with your feet resting on the floor for support.
Allow your arms to hang straight down.
Keeping your elbows still, raise the bar up towards your head, contracting your biceps.
In a controlled manner lower the weight and repeat.
tips: Practise steady movements in this exercise, and be careful not to let your arms sway.
